axes.label: Single-target and area friendly Magic removal
Single-target and area enemy Magic removal

notes: Purify or Mass Dispel removes Paralyzing Shots; Phantasm removes its snare from the Priest while preserving Mass Dispel for another wave.
Improved Purify removes Regurgitate's Disease after a failed frontal. Mind Soothe has niche Humanoid routing value but mixed Beast packs limit it; Shackle Horror is unused.
Mass Dispel is especially valuable for Ikuzz's party roots because they are harmful Magic effects; Phantasm does not remove those roots but helps with eligible trash snares.
Beast-heavy pulls limit Mind Soothe, and the guide lists no Disease or Shackle Horror application.
The ice section applies multiple rounds of multi-target Magic debuffs suited to Mass Dispel. Phantasm removes eligible snares such as a missed Frigid Roar from the Priest.
There are no listed Diseases or Aberration/Undead targets; Mind Soothe has limited Humanoid routing value.
Mass Dispel efficiently removes multi-target Corroding Spittle applications during Kystia Manaheart and large Felwyrm pulls.
Mind Soothe has broad Humanoid value for avoiding accidental body pulls; the guide lists Phantasm, Improved Purify, and Shackle Horror as unused.
Regular Purify usually covers planned dispels; Mass Dispel and Phantasm are recovery tools when missed casts spread dispellable effects or snares.
Mind Soothe cannot affect the dungeon's Aberrations. Shackle Horror can control an isolated Aberration or stop a selected patrol, but only when the route justifies the talent.
Single-target Purify is usually sufficient for Imbued Conduction; Mass Dispel remains a niche multi-removal or stealth-pull tool.
Mind Soothe has route-dependent value on eligible Humanoids. The guide lists no snares, Diseases, or Shackle Horror application.
Dispel Magic or Mass Dispel removes Bound by Shadow from shadow minions before their fixates and fears become dangerous. Phantasm is mandatory-value self-removal for repeated Frost Shock snares.
Improved Purify is safety coverage for Wretched Discharge after missed Mchimba casts. Shackle Horror controls Undead targets and can briefly stop ranged-targeting raptors before damage breaks it.
Mass Dispel is a core choice for repeated enemy shields and provides another friendly dispel for Cold Claws before the tank reaches the stun threshold.
Phantasm is niche self-snare coverage. Mind Soothe can reduce accidental Humanoid or Dragonkin body pulls where the route permits; Improved Purify and Shackle Horror are unused.

recommendations: Use Psychic Scream after the orbs settle, then Dispel Magic stragglers; Mass Dispel can remove up to five enemy Magic effects when positioning permits.
Prioritize damage into the one-health emissary's shield; Shadow Word: Death gains execute value, but this is damage rather than a dispel interaction.
Collect allies' orbiting orbs and position your own so another player can collect it.

Mass Dispel removes up to five party applications because the omni-debuff includes Magic; Phantasm removes the Priest's own snare component when Mass Dispel is unavailable, while healing remains a valid fallback.
